clauses.title: Exact autofix names the cleanup result terminal
requires: a successful cleanup result — from `workspace_cleanup_created` or `workspace_cleanup` — is the terminal workspace evidence
no `workspace_*` operation may target the removed path afterwards
the terminal recheck after removal is operator-side only
a post-removal verification failure is a caller error, never evidence about the target

clauses.title: Cleanup-terminal fixtures pin the prose and the returned evidence
requires: the cleanup result is named terminal and post-removal workspace calls are forbidden
the cleanup operation already returns the terminal evidence it is now named for
